body:
Rhodochrosite is a rare manganese carbonate found in only a few mines around the world, and most of the known sources are now depleted, making this vibrant pink specimen an extra-special treat! This gem gently yet firmly encourages you to recognize your own worth — and demands that others do the same. It reminds you to never settle in love — to hold out for the kind of love that you truly deserve.

If you’re looking for your soulmate — the type of unconditional love that only comes from a place of deep understanding — Rhodochrosite will be your companion and teacher. This gem attracts love by opening and healing the heart chakra, allowing you to love without fear or reservation. It connects you with your inner child, allowing your spirit to soar as old emotional wounds melt away.

As we age, our perception of love matures alongside us. Rhodochrosite allows us to expand our understanding of love, and teaches us to be selfless in our relationships. It seeks to show us all that we can give to those we love. How can we help those around us? How can we love their faults, love away their pain, and express love through positive intentions? When we ask these questions — and truly put in the work to seek out those answers — unconditional love is waiting on the other side.
